label: r4c2
name: x-flip, 16 minibatches
hypothesis: This is the best net (x-flip, no obs views) with 16 minibatches instead of 8. That doubles the gradient steps at the same sample count, which should help sample efficiency on the fixed budget. Earlier worlds and r3c5 found this within noise. More than 0.95 supports it. Less than 0.80 refutes it, which would mean the extra steps overfit each batch.
